A second word-event opens the burial command, “Yahweh’s word came to me the second time” (web:Jer.13.3), spliced וַיְהִ֧י דְבַר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י שֵׁנִ֥ית לֵאמֹֽר (oshb:Jer.13.3, byte tier), and after “many days” a further time-and-place transition opens the recovery, “Arise, go to the Euphrates” (web:Jer.13.6), on וַיְהִ֕י מִקֵּ֖ץ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י (oshb:Jer.13.6, byte tier); the interpretation phase then opens its own word-event at 13:8, וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר (oshb:Jer.13.8, byte tier). Command (13:1-2), the burial-and-recovery performance (13:3-7, spanning the time-and-place shift at 13:6), and the interpretation (13:8-11, closing “the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to me”, web:Jer.13.11) stay one unit on that ground.
